sources.title: GitHub - DikovAlexandr/ActivationSteeringRepair · GitHub
sources.snippet: Minimal reproducible experiment on whether a denoising autoencoder can repair fluency degradation caused by activation addition without erasing the intended persona direction. The frozen models are Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B; evaluation uses the same four traits, prompts, generation seeds, and intervention strengths for every method.

sources.title: Steering Language Models With Activation Engineering
sources.snippet: Prompt engineering and finetuning aim to maximize language model performance on a given metric (like toxicity reduction). However, these methods do not fully elicit a model's capabilities. To reduce this gap, we introduce activation engineering: the inference-time modification of activations in order to control (or steer) model outputs.
